# High-frequency approach to benchmark index tracking

## Description

Proposed high-frequency approach to benchmark index tracking: Choose portfolio weights to track a target index while controlling tracking error, turnover, liquidity constraints, and transaction costs; this is an allocation objective, not inherently a return-prediction edge. This is a concept-level interpretation of the title, not a complete trading specification: the exact model inputs/target, calibration, entry/exit or rebalance rules, and position sizing are not fully defined here.
